messages.author: 9c5d22292e637ac4
messages.subject: autocorrelation
parts:
Dear all

I am using the single season occupancy model in unmarked. But I think there could be spatial autocorrelation (between sites) in my data. I was wondering if there is a way to account for this in unmarked or in any other package of R (which uses the maximum likelihood approach)?
Thanks for your help!

messages.author: 6a288128bce8283d
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] autocorrelation
parts:
Hi Ramya,

I'm not aware of a way to properly do this in a maximum likelihood framework. Only way I know is using a Bayesian framework as we did here: http://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0099292

Cheers,
Richard
